|previous_update = [[Release v1.8]] |next_update = [[Release v1.10|Polluted Wasteland Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Release v1.9''' was the twenty-first update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 6th of April 2020. This update is notable for bringing the [[Spring 2020 Event]], the fifth event in Tower Defense Simulator. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Release v1.9''' has been retroactively applied to this update. However, since this update brought the [[Spring 2020 Event]] which was a part of the [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]], it can also be called the '''Egg Hunt 2020 Update'''. This version encompassed six updates, the main Release v1.9.0 update (released 6 April 2020) and five minor updates, Release v1.9.0a (released 6 April 2020), Release v1.9.0b (released 7 April 2020), Release v1.9.0c (released 11 April 2020), Release v1.9.0d (released 12 April 2020) and Release v1.9.0e (released 17 April 2020). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Swarmer]] ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were added as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. *[[Zombegg]] *[[Sugrawr]] *[[Eggsplosive]] *[[Hunter (Eggy Island)|Hunter]] *[[Bunny]] *[[Sir Hopsalot]] *[[Beehive]] *[[Grizzly]] *[[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]] ===Maps=== :One map was added as part of the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. *[[Eggy Island]] ===Crates=== *[[Bunny Crate]] **Skins: ***[[Medic]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Commander]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Mortar]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Minigunner]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Scout]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Paintballer]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Sniper]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Ranger|Outlaw]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Pyromancer]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ***[[Electroshocker]]: {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Spring 2020 Event]] *Star creator request GUI *New lobby *New [[Codes|code]]: SPR1NGM1L3ST0NE **Gives {{Color|Other|Spring Time}} [[Slasher|Shredder]] skin *New [[Codes|code]]: HAPPY3AST3R! **Gives {{Color|Other|Spring Time}} [[Commander]] skin ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Ranger|Outlaw]]'s Default, {{Color|Basic|Green}}, {{Color|Basic|Blue}} and {{Color|Basic|Black Ops}} appearance changed. *[[Scout]]'s all skins appearance changed. *[[Paintballer]]'s all skins appearance changed. *New sound effects for the [[Sniper]] and [[Scout]]. *New sound effects for the {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} and {{Color|Golden|Golden}} [[Cowboy]] skins. :In '''Release v1.9.0a''': *[[Swarmer]] can no longer be bought for {{Coins|2,500}}. :In '''Release v1.9.0b''': *[[Swarmer]]'s ''Beehive Grenade'' ability now always targets the first enemy. *[[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]] can no longer stun the [[Medic]]. :In '''Release v1.9.0c''': *[[Eggy Island]] ambient music changed. :Gamepass prices decreased as part of the Easter Sale 2020 in '''Release v1.9.0d''': *[[Archer|Holiday Archer]] is available through a gamepass for {{Robux|350}}. *[[Crook Boss]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|400}} to {{Robux|350}}. *[[DJ Booth]]'s custom Music gamepass price decreased from {{Robux|150}} to {{Robux|100}}. :Gamepass prices increased as the Easter Sale 2020 ended in '''Release v1.9.0e''': *[[Archer|Holiday Archer]] gamepass taken offasle. *[[Crook Boss]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|350}} to {{Robux|400}}. *[[DJ Booth]]'s custom Music gamepass price increased from {{Robux|100}} to {{Robux|150}}. ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's update log on the devforum. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===Release v1.9.0=== *[[Spring 2020 Event|SPRING EVENT]]! 🌻 **Beat on easy mode for Tower of Eggs **Beat on hard mode for [[Swarmer]] tower *[[Swarmer|SWARMER]] TOWER 🐝 *BUNNY SKINS 🐇 **[[Minigunner]] **[[Scout]] **[[Sniper]] **[[Mortar]] **[[Pyromancer]] **[[Medic]] **[[Paintballer]] **[[Electroshocker]] **[[Commander]] **[[Ranger|Outlaw]] *New [[scout]] appearance *New [[paintballer]] appearance *New [[outlaw]] appearance *Lowered price of Golden [[Scout]] *New SFX *Spring Time Skins (exclusive) **[[Slasher|Shredder]] **[[Commander]] *Lobby updates **Grass **Statues **Trees **Signs *Star Creator request gui *Bug fixes {{UpdateNavBox}} [[Category:Release Updates]]
